Ben Carter here — quick tracing guidance to include in the checklist: 

- Span naming convention: service.operation.resource (e.g., auth.login.http / inference.request.grpc)
- Root span: Include request id header (x-request-id) and user_id or account_id when present (PII rules apply)
- Sampling: use 1% tail sampling for production by default; 100% for error traces and selected traffic (e.g., <trace-sample key>)
- Background jobs: prefix spans with job.<worker_name> and include idempotency keys
- Instrumentation points: incoming request, model inference entry, cache hit/miss, downstream DB call, external API latency

Attachments we’ll drop into the shared drive before the meeting: datadog-dashboard-template.json, runbook-template.md (populated), and an alert-routing matrix (CSV).

Action items before kickoff (owner -> ETA):
- Mateo: send calendar invite + attendee list (today)
- Sara/PlatformOps: provide a short list of critical services (3–5) you want prioritized (today)
- Ben: prepare tracing checklist + two example spans for engineer handoff (tomorrow morning)
- Marissa: create runbook skeleton with incident triage steps for review (tomorrow)

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
